airports.name: FAA CY2025 Commercial Service Enplanements
limitations: Annual calendar-year enplanements; FAA region (RO) and state (ST) are used for regional filtering.
Locid is the FAA location identifier; for commercial airports it normally equals the IATA code used by BTS.

ontime.name: BTS Reporting Carrier On-Time Performance
limitations: Reporting (large US passenger) carriers only; cargo carriers and foreign carriers are not included.
Single month; delay and taxi-out levels are seasonal.
Delay causes are attached to delayed arrivals and are airline-reported attributions.

t100_segments.name: BTS T-100 Segment (All Carriers)
t100_segments.retrieval_method: public TranStats download form (ASP.NET POST; not an API)
limitations: Monthly route segments for all carriers (US and foreign) reporting T-100; aggregated over carriers.
DISTANCE is the published distance between airports in statute miles (A-016: matches great-circle statute miles within ~0.3% on 400 sampled routes).
Service classes: F scheduled passenger/cargo, G scheduled all-cargo, L non-scheduled passenger/cargo, P non-scheduled all-cargo.
Single month; route mix can be seasonal.

bts_api_fallback.name: Recorded BTS SODA API response (r495-tyji)
bts_api_fallback.retrieval_method: SODA JSON API, recorded for outage fallback only
limitations: Used only if the live API is unavailable; always labelled as recorded, never as live.
